title: Scout relevance holdout export record
description: One JSON-lines record per pending held post, written by `scout holdout export`. Extends the population export format assay already reads: every PopulationExportRecord field is present and unchanged. The `private` envelope carries the production decision a blind reviewer must not see, as one named key so a blind projection can drop it and be checked.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bumped whenever a consumer must change to keep reading this.

holdout_id.description: Identity a label joins back on. Unique per hold.

evaluation_id.description: The immutable source evaluation this hold references.

project.description: The routed project frozen as it stood at decision time. A label joins against this, never against the project's current registry row.

human_label.description: Any pre-existing human relevance label on the source evaluation. Null for a post held at decision time, which is the ordinary case.

production_decision.description: The decision boundary the classifier recorded: true for respond or review, false for drop. This is production's intent, not what downstream did with it — a held post's actual surface_status is `held`, and a released one may still be stopped by the critic, the verifier or a rate cap. It can disagree with the source evaluation's `relevant`: an LLM case that was relevant but under the threshold in force at decision time recorded `drop` and reads false here.

held_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant the hold was taken.

private.description: Never shown to a blind reviewer. A blind projection drops this key whole; assay's packet builder asserts nothing on its denylist survived.

action.description: The recorded classifier action. Release falls back to this when a case is ungraded.

classifier.description: What produced the decision. Null members mean unknown and are never guessed at; a pre-JEV evaluation carries nulls throughout.
